compiled_state.title: check-sprint-trailer.sh checks HEAD parent — fails after origin/main merge into sprint worktree
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Summary
plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh inspects HEAD via 'git log -1 --format=%B' during pre-commit, which inspects the PARENT of the in-progress commit (not the new commit message). When origin/main is merged into a sprint worktree (.sprint-active present, workflow=ci-pr), the resulting merge commit lacks the DSO-Story trailer and becomes HEAD. Every subsequent commit on the sprint worktree then fails the hook regardless of whether the new commit message contains the trailer.

## Reproduction
1. Start sprint (.sprint-active created), commit work with proper DSO-Story trailers
2. Sync from origin: 'git merge origin/main' creates a merge commit (no trailer)
3. Attempt any subsequent commit on the sprint worktree, even with 'DSO-Story: <id>' trailer included
4. Hook fails: "DSO-Story trailer required in sprint mode but not found in commit message"

## Expected
Hook should validate the in-progress commit message (passed by git via the commit-msg hook stage or via .git/COMMIT_EDITMSG), not HEAD.

## Actual
Hook checks HEAD's message via 'git log -1 --format=%B'. Since the recent merge commit at HEAD has no trailer, ALL subsequent commits fail until HEAD is moved past the merge.

## Environment
- Branch: worktree-20260516-155317
- .sprint-active present, dso.workflow=ci-pr
- HEAD: 2f87bb88f8 'Merge remote-tracking branch origin/main into worktree-20260516-155317' (no trailer)
- Hook file: plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh:22 — '_commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format=%B 2>/dev/null || echo "")'
- Pre-commit config: .pre-commit-config.yaml:228-232 (registered at default pre-commit stage, no stages: [commit-msg] declared)

## Suggested fix
Move hook to 'commit-msg' stage and read message from $1 (the path to .git/COMMIT_EDITMSG), instead of pre-commit + git log HEAD.

## Discovered during
Task 24a2-401b-a6b3-420d (RED tests for cycle_dispatcher), Story 45da-5043-aa3e-4f3c, Epic b575-ac1c-f720-4839. Spec instructed a raw 'git commit' which was blocked by this hook misfire.

## CLI_user
no — agent-discovered during sprint execution.

comments.body: Already fixed: duplicate of aba6-56fa-8176-4801 (archived). check-sprint-trailer.sh now reads in-progress message via $1 or $GIT_DIR/COMMIT_EDITMSG (commit 3a11f3379f) and is registered at the commit-msg stage in .pre-commit-config.yaml:236 (commit 4b94a52fad). Tests: tests/hooks/test-check-sprint-trailer.sh PASSED 8/0 and tests/hooks/test-sprint-trailer-registration.sh PASSED 4/0. Closing as already-resolved.
